settings.title: Settings
settings.dailyReminderHint: A reminder to record the day's spending. It also names any account at or below its alert line.
settings.backupReminderHint: A reminder to export a backup, on the day and time you choose.
settings.alertsHint: A notification when spending reaches 75%, 90% or 100% of a limit, or an account drops to its alert line.
settings.permissionDenied: Notifications are turned off for this app in Android settings. Warnings inside the app still work.
settings.exportBackupHint: Everything in the app. Use it to restore on this phone or move to a new one.
settings.exportCsvHint: Your entries as a spreadsheet file, for Excel or Google Sheets.
settings.importBackupHint: Restore from a JSON backup, or merge one into what's already here.
settings.notificationsUnavailable: Notifications don't work in Expo Go, because Expo removed notification support from it. They work in a development build or the installed app. Warnings inside the app work everywhere.

home.noEntries: No entries yet. Tap + to add your first.
home.noAccountsBody: Accounts are where your money lives: cash, a bank account or an e-wallet.

accountForm.name: Name
accountForm.openingBalanceHint: The balance before your first entry in this app. Tap + to switch to negative, e.g. for a credit card.
accountForm.alertLineHint: The account is flagged when its balance reaches this amount or lower.
accountForm.archiveHint: Archived accounts leave the pickers and the total, but keep their history.

entries.emptyBody: Tap + to record spending or income.

entryForm.noAccount: Add an account before recording entries.

amount.mustBePositive: The amount must be more than zero.

transfers.title: Transfers
transfers.emptyBody: Tap + to move money between your accounts.
transfers.needTwoAccounts: Add a second account to move money between accounts.

errors.invalidFee: Enter a valid fee, or leave it empty.
errors.feeExceedsAmount: When the recipient pays, the fee can't be more than the amount.

reconcile.title: Reconcile balance
reconcile.hint: Enter the real balance from your bank app, e-wallet or wallet. Any difference is recorded as Unrecorded.
reconcile.realBalanceHint: Check your bank app, e-wallet or wallet and enter what it shows.
reconcile.matches: The balances match. Nothing to record.
reconcile.noFuture: Choose today or an earlier date.
reconcile.datedOn: The difference is recorded as an Unrecorded adjustment dated {{date}}. You can then give it a category or split it.

adjustment.title: Unrecorded adjustment
adjustment.categorizeHint: Give the whole amount a category. It becomes a normal entry.
adjustment.splitHint: Split part or all of it across categories. Anything left stays Unrecorded.
adjustment.exceeds: The parts add up to more than the adjustment.
adjustment.partNeedsAmount: Enter an amount above zero for each part.
adjustment.partNeedsCategory: Choose a category for each part.
adjustment.noneLeft: No unrecorded adjustments left in this period.

summary.emptyBody: Entries you add for these dates will show up here.

categories.title: Categories
categories.name: Name
categories.duplicate: A category with this name already exists for this type.
categories.builtinHint: Unrecorded and Transfer fees are filled in by the app and can't be changed or archived.
categories.archiveHint: Archived categories leave the pickers but stay on existing entries and in past summaries.

budgets.title: Budgets
budgets.intro: Limits repeat every month until you change them. Unused budget doesn't carry over.
budgets.appliesFrom: Applies from {{month}} on. Earlier months keep the limits they had.

scopeHint.overall: Counts all spending, including transfer fees and unrecorded spending.
scopeHint.account: Counts all spending from this account, including transfer fees it paid and unrecorded spending.
scopeHint.category: Counts spending in this category from every account.

budgets.alertLevel: {{name}}: {{percent}}% of this month's limit used ({{spent}} of {{limit}}).
budgets.alertReached: {{name}}: this month's limit is used up ({{spent}} of {{limit}}).

import.title: Import backup
import.intro: Choose a JSON backup exported from this app. The whole file is checked first, and nothing changes until you confirm.
import.contains: Contains {{entries}} entries, {{transfers}} transfers, {{accounts}} accounts, {{categories}} categories and {{budgets}} budgets.
import.mergeHint: Adds what's new and keeps everything already on this phone. Records already here are skipped, and accounts and categories with the same name are combined.
import.replaceHint: Deletes everything on this phone and restores the backup exactly, including settings.
import.confirmBody: Everything on this phone will be replaced by the backup. This can't be undone.
import.addedSummary: Added {{entries}} entries, {{transfers}} transfers, {{accounts}} accounts and {{categories}} categories.
import.replacedSummary: Restored {{entries}} entries, {{transfers}} transfers, {{accounts}} accounts and {{categories}} categories.
import.skippedSummary: Skipped {{count}} records that were already on this phone.

errors.notABackup: This isn't a backup file from Budget Tracker. Nothing was changed.
errors.newerVersion: This backup comes from a newer version of the app. Update the app, then try again.
errors.invalid: This backup is damaged or incomplete ({{detail}}). Nothing was changed.
errors.failed: The import stopped and nothing was changed: {{message}}

notifications.backupBody: Export a backup so your records are safe if you change or reset your phone.
notifications.balanceBody: {{name}} is at {{balance}}, at or below its alert line of {{line}}.
